task.title: Add a failure_streak counter and quarantined status to the task schema

scope.owned_layer: Task-row failure-streak projection, threshold quarantine, governed lifecycle resets, and the completion cleanup of per-provider runtime evidence.
scope.not_changing: Provider classification, retry budgets, dispatch priority, review authority, or live runtime configuration.

review_remediation.required_change: A worker completion must clear every task-provider bucket, not only the completing worker's bucket; the regression must prove a rotated provider retries at streak one after the task-row reset. The exact-head Contents API lookup must use explicit GET with a query ref so gh does not infer POST from -f ref=<sha> and falsely reject this committed manifest.
review_remediation.evidence_requirement: This manifest is committed in PR #4533 before independent re-review and must be bound with REVIEW_FILE during exact-head approval.

acceptance.failure_projection: Repeated distinct worker failures increment the task-row failure_streak.
acceptance.quarantine: The configured failure-loop threshold changes the task status to quarantined and normal dispatch ignores it until governed reopen.
acceptance.success_reset: Worker completion resets the task-row failure_streak and clears detailed records for every provider on that task.
acceptance.cross_provider_reset: A later failure from a provider that had a pre-completion record starts at one and leaves the task in_progress.

commands.result: True; GitHub Contents API verified the committed manifest at rejected PR #4533 head b5509721342745174d25ce10134be342b80c50c1 using the explicit GET query.

commands.command: python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/supervisor.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py scripts/ai_status.py scripts/test_ai_status.py && git diff --check

review.approval_protocol: Review this committed manifest and the exact PR head, then approve with REVIEW_FILE=docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-TASK-FAILURE-STREAK-SCHEMA-20260804/evidence.json.
review.prior_review: The canonical review bridge rejected the prior head because completion left rotated provider buckets and no REVIEW_FILE-eligible manifest was in the PR diff. The later b5509721342745174d25ce10134be342b80c50c1 manifest was present at the PR head, but the verifier sent -f ref=<sha>, making gh infer POST; this patch uses an explicit GET query and adds a focused exact-head regression.

delivery.candidate_head: to be supplied by the exact-head independent review
